page.layout: Two printed pages on the scan. Left page: only its outer strip is visible at the left edge, holding fragments of marginal notes. Right page: one column of running text, with the running head and page number at the top and a gathering signature at the foot. No notes in the right margin.

p.i: rior, qui consideratur vel absolutè, ut miles, vel ut officiarius in bello.
In milite duo spectanda sunt; 1, eius vocatio & constitutio; 2, distinctio eius.
Circa constitutionem militis tria sunt consi-deranda; 1, conscriptio militis; 2, probatio seu lu-stratio; denique 3, receptio & auctoratio.
Circa conscriptionem militis spectentur tria; 1, modus conscriptionis; 2, unde conscribendus sit miles; & 3, qualis sit conscri-bendus.
Modus conscribendi militem, est vel primarius, vel secundarius.
Modus primarius est, qui fit debito tempo-ris spacio & successione.

main_text.head: De hoc sunt Canones:
main_text.p: mes esta Deocertistas, il-felici-1 Princeps & dux belli certos emittat conquisi-tores, qui ex diversis locis militem conscribant.

p.i: Secundarius modus est, qui repentè & tumultuariè fit; hostè nim. ex improviso irruente, cuius modi indicia esse solent pulsus campanæ, vel sonitus fulminalis machinæ, vel etiam vexillum expansum, &c.

main_text.p: Notes on the left page's outer margin are fragments cut by the gutter and are partly illegible; their readings are given as far as they can be seen.

page.notes: The left-edge strip shows only the right-hand ends of marginal notes from the left printed page, cut off at the gutter. Their words are fragmentary and many are doubtful; they are placed beside the paragraphs of this page only as a rough guide, not as their true position. The catchword is not printed. Two marks in the text are ink or foxing stains and are not transcribed.
